## Using incidence files to impose a prevalence distribution of e.g. the RISK dimension

The XML fragment below shows how to specify a RISK incidence file. The attribute **target.prevalence** is required to handle the fractions specified in the incidence file as prevalences.

``` xml
  <RISK>
    <RISK.stages>
      <stage name="normalwt" fraction.at.birth="1"/>
      <stage name="underwt" />
      <stage name="underwtcount" />
    </RISK.stages>
    <RISK.incidence>
      <incidence.data file="data/RISK-incidence-2040-NAM_count.txt" times="1980,2051" values="1,1" 
      proportions="false" denominator="susc" once.per.year="true" target.prevalence="true"/>
    </RISK.incidence>
```

| YEAR | country | dim  | from     | to                      | TB  | 0    | 15   | 50   |
|------|---------|------|----------|-------------------------|-----|------|------|------|
| 1979 | NAM     | RISK | normalwt | "underwt, underwtcount" | NA  | 0    | 0    | 0    |
| .    |         |      |          |                         |     |      |      |      |
| .    |         |      |          |                         |     |      |      |      |
| 1999 | NAM     | RISK | normalwt | "underwt, underwtcount" | NA  | 0    | 0    | 0    |
| 2000 | NAM     | RISK | normalwt | "underwt, underwtcount" | NA  | 0.01 | 0.03 | 0.05 |
| 2001 | NAM     | RISK | normalwt | "underwt, underwtcount" | NA  | 0.02 | 0.04 | 0.06 |
| 2002 | NAM     | RISK | normalwt | "underwt, underwtcount" | NA  | 0.03 | 0.05 | 0.07 |

The table above specifies that e.g. for the year 2000 the prevalence of **underwt** in 0 thru 14 year olds should be 0.01 (i.e. 1%) and that recruitment should take place from the **normalwt** state. The **underwtcount** is just to keep track of movements from **normalwt** to **underwt**.

From the current version of TBvax, it is required that in the \<detailed.output\> element the RISK flows should be specified:

```xml
    <detailed.output years="c(2005,2005.5, 2015,2015.5, 2017, 2017.5)" age.group.lower.limits="c(0,15,40)" econ.output="false" suppress.zeros.in.stocks="false" suppress.zeros.in.flows="false" combine.stocks.and.flows="false">
      <flows dim="TB" incidence="false" transmission="true" progression="true" treatment="true"/>
      <flows dim="HIV" incidence="true" transmission="false" progression="true" treatment="true"/>
      <flows dim="VXa" incidence="false" transmission="false" progression="false" treatment="false"/>
      <flows dim="RISK" incidence="true" transmission="false" progression="false" treatment="false" />
    </detailed.output>
```

i.e. the <flows> element for dim="RISK" now is a required element. To obtain output on RISK flows specify incidence="true".
